name: omarchy-agentic-stale-advice
description: Two config changes where the widely-published answer is the Omarchy 3 / hyprlang one and is wrong on Omarchy 4. Tests whether an agent goes confidently wrong, not whether it can act.

tasks.prompt:
Omarchy binds SUPER + W to "close window" by default. Change it so that SUPER + W
launches the Nautilus file manager instead.

The change must survive an `omarchy update`, and every other default binding must
keep working. Make the change, then stop.
tasks.seed:
set -euo pipefail
# A previous case's wrong answer must not be scored as this one's. Both paths are
# absent on a stock Omarchy 4, so this only ever removes leftovers.
if [ -d "$HOME/.local/share/omarchy" ]; then rm -rf "$HOME/.local/share/omarchy"; fi
rm -f "$HOME/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf"

tasks.prompt:
Turn off window gaps and window borders on this machine: inner gaps 0, outer gaps 0,
and border size 0.

The change must survive an `omarchy update`. Make the change, then stop.
tasks.seed:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -d "$HOME/.local/share/omarchy" ]; then rm -rf "$HOME/.local/share/omarchy"; fi
rm -f "$HOME/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf"
